preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and len(set(a)) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a)
preconditions.description: The list a contains n distinct integers, each between 1 and n inclusive.
There are exactly n - 1 edges provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 1 and n.
The set of edges forms a valid tree (connected, acyclic, undirected).

postconditions.description: The output is an integer modulo 10^9 + 7.

The output equals the sum of f(u, v) over all ordered pairs (u, v) with u != v, multiplied by the modular inverse of n(n-1), modulo 10^9 + 7. Here total_sum is the sum of phi(a[u-1] * a[v-1]) * dist(u, v) for all u != v, and MOD is 10^9 + 7.
